title: Provider files API (upload once, reference by ID)
description: chatlas PR #334 adds a provider files API that lets you upload a file once and reference it by ID for the rest of the conversation, avoiding re-sending bytes on every turn. ellmer issue #868 ('Add openAI files api') is open but no PR has been merged implementing this feature in ellmer.

title: content_document_file() and content_document_url() for text/CSV/code files
description: chatlas PR #345 adds content_document_file() and content_document_url() helpers so users can pass text, Markdown, CSV, or code files directly to a chat the same way they pass images or PDFs. ellmer has no equivalent helpers and no open PR covering this feature.

title: Fail loudly when a built-in tool isn't supported by the provider
description: chatlas PR #370 makes tool_web_search() and tool_web_fetch() raise a clear error when used with a provider that doesn't natively support them, instead of silently sending an empty or malformed tool definition. ellmer has no equivalent guard and no open PR covering this.

title: Fix: a tool call gets exactly one result (consolidate multi-chunk tool results)
description: chatlas PR #363 fixes a bug where MCP servers returning multiple output chunks (e.g. text plus an image) caused providers like Anthropic to error with 'each tool_use must have a single result'. The fix consolidates multiple result blocks into a single tool result. ellmer issue #1060 ('contents_record() fails for tool results mixing Content and plain values') is related but open with no merged fix yet.

title: Explain truncated responses instead of failing to parse them
description: chatlas PR #344 catches the case where a structured-output response is truncated at the token limit and raises a clear ValueError pointing to max_tokens, instead of a confusing JSONDecodeError. ellmer has no equivalent guard and no open PR covering this specific structured-output truncation error path.

title: ChatGoogle() records built-in web search and fetch tool activity in turns
description: chatlas PR #341 ensures that when ChatGoogle() uses tool_web_search() or tool_web_fetch(), the queries and pages consulted are recorded in the turn history, matching the behaviour of ChatAnthropic() and ChatOpenAI(). ellmer has no open PR covering this gap for the Google provider.

title: Replay built-in tool content only to the provider that produced it
description: chatlas PR #336 prevents built-in tool content (web search results, fetch results) from being sent to a different provider when turns are shared via set_turns(), which previously caused 400 errors or ValueErrors. ellmer has no equivalent guard and no open PR covering this.

title: Update ChatGroq() default model
description: chatlas PR #331 updates ChatGroq() default model from llama-3.1-8b-instant to openai/gpt-oss-20b for a more capable out-of-the-box experience. ellmer has no open PR updating the ChatGroq equivalent default model.

title: Add Gemini batch support
description: chatlas PR #329 adds batch_chat() support for ChatGoogle() (Gemini Developer API). ellmer's batch_chat() does not yet support the Google Gemini provider and no open ellmer PR covers this.

title: Add Bedrock Converse provider support
description: chatlas PR #377 adds a native Bedrock Runtime Converse provider with SigV4 authentication and sync/async event-stream handling, supporting turns, media, tools, reasoning, structured output, and cache controls. ellmer has an open PR #1064 for bedrock-mantle support but the Converse API support (the original bedrock-runtime endpoint) already exists in ellmer; however, chatlas now has a fully separate ChatBedrock() class for Converse models distinct from BedrockAnthropic. The ellmer equivalent would be ensuring chat_aws_bedrock() properly handles all Converse API models beyond just Claude.

title: Render inline images compactly when echoing
description: chatlas PR #376 makes echoed screenshots, plots, and model-generated images render as terminal thumbnails (using Pillow) or compact metadata rather than dumping raw base64 data URIs. ellmer's echo/display path for image content may similarly benefit from compact rendering instead of printing raw base64 strings, especially for knitr/Quarto contexts (related to ellmer issue #220).

title: Display web search, fetch, and citations when echoing
description: chatlas PR #372 adds visual panels showing web search queries, results, and citations when echoing at the default output level. ellmer has an open PR #1068 for citation content, but the echo/display rendering of search and fetch tool results as formatted panels is a separate UX improvement that ellmer's echo path may still be missing.
